page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the ecs.s2 instance family. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores, with 1.0 thread per core. This dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times for standard workloads.

The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not feature any local storage or GPU hardware, meaning all data persistence must be handled via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the CPU configuration lacks advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags.

Given its balanced resource profile and dedicated CPU cores, this instance is designed for entry-level production environments. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require stable CPU performance without the overhead of high-performance vector processing. Appropriate use cases include lightweight web serving, small application backends, development environments, and basic database hosting.
